text:
Clara: Quick sync — Aether Systems early access preview. NDA is signed (https://rwd.co/internal/aether-nda). Need to finalize benchmark plan, feedback loop, and decide if/when a joint announcement happens. Proposed timeline: 6 weeks. Thoughts?

Evan: On it. Do we have Aether images + runtime artifacts? I need driver build, CUDA/CU version, container runtime, and a sample 13B model + perf scripts to run.

Priya: I'll draft a benchmark matrix: throughput (tokens/s), p50/p95 latency, memory footprint, quantization impact (4-bit vs 8-bit), batch scaling, and warm vs cold KV cache. Will need sample prompts and sequence-length distribution.

Sam: Heads up — Aether requested an embargo until 2024-07-15 for any joint press. They also asked about cloud marketplace listing later in Q3. We should decide now if this is an "EAP only" or "co-marketed" preview.

Clara: Good notes. Evan please list infra reqs + a runbook for reproducible perf runs. Priya please add an eval harness + golden prompt set. Sam please draft a short announcement decision tree (EAP-only vs co-announcement vs co-marketing timeline). Legal owner is legal@redwood for NDA artifacts.

Evan: ETA for infra reqs: EOD Friday. I'll include a kernel/driver checklist, NVLink topology notes, and a perf sanity script (bash + python). Example perf command I'll run:
```
python perf_runner.py --model 13b --batch 1,2,4 --seq 512 --warmup 20 --steps 200
```
Will push artifacts to the aether-eap S3 bucket.

Priya: I'll provision the eval harness on a small fleet and run an initial baseline by Tue. Need access to the Aether images and the sample model. @Clara can you share creds? Also want to include regression detection hooks: unit prompts, hallucination checks, and BLEU/ROUGE-like metrics for structured outputs.

partnerbot (aether-bot): Aether: credentials invited to rwd-eap account — invite expires in 72h. Link: https://aether.example/invite/abcd

Clara: Sent creds and edit access to the benchmark spreadsheet: https://rwd.co/sheets/aether-eap. I've given Evan/Priya/Sam edit.

Sam: :thumbsup:

Evan: One technical risk: Aether's NVLink topology and different SM architecture could change large-seq perf behavior (KV cache behavior). We should document fallback strategies: smaller batches, split-KV to host, and a compatible lower-capacity model variant for latency-sensitive routes.

Priya: Agree. We'll include regression alerts and a daily feedback digest to Aether with sample failed prompts and perf anomalies. Suggested sync cadence: twice-weekly engineering sync + weekly product/partner digest.

Clara: Decision: proceed with EAP. Formal kickoff Thursday 10:00am PT — I'll book and invite Aether PM + infra lead.

Clara: Action items (summary):
- Clara: kickoff invite, share legal NDA location, verify credential expiry windows.
- Evan: infra reqs + perf scripts (EOD Fri).
- Priya: eval harness, baseline runs, benchmark matrix (baseline Tue).
- Sam: announcement decision tree + embargo checklist.
- All: review benchmark spreadsheet and add any missing metrics.

Evan: Roger. I'll also add a short troubleshooting checklist to the sheet (driver mismatches, tensor core fallbacks).

Priya: I'll add the golden prompt set to the sheet and mark which prompts map to which metric buckets.

Clara: Thanks team — I'll send calendar + invite now and loop in legal and alliances. If anything urgent, ping me directly.
